data.name: Yosemite High Country & Mariposa Grove Full Day Small Group Tour & Hike
data.headline: Head up to the high country and see Giant Sequoias!
data.description:
Join Good Trip Adventures for an intimate small-group expedition delving into the high country of Yosemite National Park. Head up to the high country and see Giant Sequoias on this action packed day! Immerse yourself in the stunning alpine landscapes, pristine lakes, and iconic granite peaks that define this extraordinary region.

Our seasoned guides will immerse you in Yosemite's natural wonders, sharing the park’s formation story, indigenous cultures, historical significance, and insights into its diverse flora and fauna.
data.highlights:
Our small-group expedition ensures a seamless adventure. Let us take care of the details, including permits and logistics, so you can fully appreciate the natural wonders surrounding you.

Our guides are not only knowledgeable but passionate about Yosemite National Park. From explaining the geological wonders to identifying unique flora and fauna, they enhance your connection with the high country’s enchanting world.
data.itinerary:
This tour includes short hikes to Taft Point and the Fissures and Sentinel Dome – two hikes that will surely test your nerve as you step over the fissures – massive cracks in the granite under our feet, walk right up to the edge of the vertical cliff face, and scramble up a massive dome. 

Not feeling like testing your fear of heights? No sweat, you can hang back and take in the views far from the edge! Next, we’ll pay a visit to Glacier Point to take in even more amazing vistas from a short walk and trip to the visitor center. We’ll either end or begin the day with a short hike in Mariposa Grove to see some of the largest living organisms on the planet.
data.what_is_included:
Private, medically trained naturalist guide
Snacks and water refills
Park entry fees
Tour in English
data.what_is_not_included:
Gratuity for your guide
Lunch (please bring a lunch)
data.what_to_bring: Reusable water bottle, sunscreen, day pack, layers to adjust to changing temperatures, camera, gratuity for your guide, packed lunch.
data.cancellation_notes: Full payment is required at time of booking. Payment is refundable up to 30 days before a trip less a 5% cancellation fee, up to 7 days before a trip less a 20% cancellation fee, and non-refundable within 7 days.
data.check_in_details: Refer to the designated start time listed when you booked your trip. Your guide will message you 1-2 days in advance to confirm details.
data.special_requirements: They say age is just a number and we (mostly) agree! However, group dynamic considerations, we do have a minimum age of 8 on our small group departures. But there’s no maximum!
data.restrictions: Participants should comfortably handle a moderate walk of 4-6 miles throughout the day, with moderate elevation changes, to make the most of their adventure.
data.disclaimers: For an authentic and personalized experience, our small-group tours are limited to 8 guests, and require a minimum of 4 guests to run. You’re welcome to book solo or with a small party. If we fall below the minimum spots booked, registrants can opt for a private tour or receive a full refund—offering flexibility for your adventure plans.
data.faqs:
Q: What will we see?
A: Yosemite National Park, nestled in the Sierra Nevada mountains of California, is a breathtaking natural wonderland renowned for its towering granite cliffs, cascading waterfalls, and diverse ecosystems. Home to iconic landmark views such as El Capitan, Half Dome, and Yosemite Falls. Throughout the day your group may see stops such as Tunnel View, Bridalveil Falls, the Ansel Adams Gallery, and peer through a spotting scope at rock climbers hanging midway up the face of El Capitan! Alternatively, your group may opt to do a longer day such as Yosemite Falls or Nevada Falls Trail with gorgeous views of the rolling smooth granite mountains and incredible waterfalls.  Along the way, your naturalist guide will share histories of the gold rush, Ahwahneechee people, and give fun facts about the flora and fauna in the area.

Q: Can we adjust the start time or trip length?
A: We will stick to our pickup time and trip length for our small-group tours. For a fully customized trip, we recommend considering our private tour options.

Q: What do we do for lunch?
A: Please pack a lunch to bring with you. Your guide will choose the perfect spot for a scenic picnic. We’ll also have snacks and a selection of beverages available, but feel free to bring along any personal favorites you might crave during the day.

Q: Do I need to tip my guide?
A: Tipping is a common way to say thanks to your guides for all their hard work. While it’s never expected, it’s always appreciated! A good rule of thumb is to tip 10-20% of the total trip cost, split between the guides. Ultimately, the amount is up to you and should reflect the level of service you feel you received. Whatever you choose, the guides will appreciate it!
